t: Peter wakes up with an absolutely killer headache.

It’s not really working.
A steady frustration is starting to build inside of himself, and he has to clamp down…

Even Steph is keeping her distance from them, though she does walk with them between…

Duke stares at him.
Maybe don’t take anymore today after that.”

And your backpack is practically empty.”

“Yeah,” Tim says, blinking up at him.
“I need them.
This is important.”
Peter shakes his head and starts in on his lunch.
Tim shrugs and goes back to whatever it is he’s working on, and the table eases into a…
Despite the general noise and ruckus in the cafeteria, Peter feels himself relax; part…

The peacefulness lasts for about five minutes before Peter is shaken out of his thoughts…

Peter replies, half panicked, wondering why on earth she's talking to him.
A second later, his brain fully engages and he’s quick to correct himself.
I’m Peter.
Felicia raises her eyebrows at him, surprised, but her smile only seems to grow.
Peter wants to crawl under the cafeteria table and die.
Forget starvation, freezing to death, Tim’s stalking, or getting killed while on patrol:…

The lady just said hi to you,” Bucky mutters.
“This is kind of adorable,” Hill says.

“What are you doing tonight, Peter?”
Felicia asks, somehow determined to continue a conversation with him despite his utter…

“Um, nothing?”
That’s not true.
He probably has some kind of Bat training set aside or something.
The Bat crew are very cagey about telling him what they’re up to; it’s almost as if they…
For right now, he doesn't have anything planned.
She takes his hand, snatches Tim’s pen out of his fingers, and uses it to write out an…

“Uh, yeah.
Sure,” Peter says dumbly.

You know, he was always my favorite back home.”

"You're the only person she's shown interest in since she started going here."

The only girl that's given him a second look is Steph, and she doesn’t even eat lunch…

Peter sighs, pinches the bridge of his nose, and deeply considers faking his own death…

Tim absently pats his shoulder comfortingly.
The rest of the day passes by quickly.
Peter hauls himself into the fire house and idly tosses his backpack over in the vague…

A date.

He’s caught somewhere between nervous excitement and vague panic.

He can’t even afford two tickets to a movie with that much.

Maybe she’d like to go skating?
The tickets won’t be too expensive, and he’d have left over for hot chocolate at the…
That wouldn’t be bad, would it?
Not thrilling, but not terrible.

“She’ll like that.”

Sam asks.

There’s a flower shop on the way.

And she’s the smartest person he’s ever met.

Hopefully it doesn’t make him look like a massive dork.

Well, decision made.

Jeans, a faded band t-shirt he picked up from the thrift store--it looked vaguely like…
Peter’s not sure a migraine will hit tonight, but he’s not taking the chance.
He runs a hand through his hair, frowns at the length, and sighs.
He checks to make sure the mice in the firehouse haven't chewed holes through his…

Peter pauses, then turns to face the cracked mirror leaning against the wall.
He does look like Tony.
Or, at least, like a very pale imitation.
The AC/DC shirt, the sport coat, the sunglasses and jeans, all of it is exactly what…

Right alongside that is Rhodey’s teasing.

Felicia lives in Old Gotham, at an apartment complex in one of the nicer, quiet parts of…
The kind of apartment that caters to middle to upper middle class workers; doctors,…
The 'working class' rich, basically.

Although he's living in an abandoned fire station in the middle of Murderville, Gotham…

They're not in the best of health, but they smell nice and look fairly pretty.
Felicia's apartment is located inside an older gothic style building, well maintained,…
Peter jogs up the stairs to the top floor, finds the right door, and then hesitates.
"Take a deep breath and relax, Peter," Shuri says, amused.
That's a tall order.
Peter takes in a deep breath and gently knocks on the door.
It opens immediately, revealing a tall, beautiful woman with short black hair and brown…

“Uh, hi,” Peter says, nervously sticking his free hand into the pocket of his sport coat.
“I’m here to see Felicia?”
She looks him up and down for a moment, makes a quiet hm sound, and then steps aside,…

Peter steps inside, but stays close to the door, wary of becoming too comfortable.
"Felicia, your date is here," the woman calls out.
She turns to Peter and offers him one elegant hand.
"I'm Selina."
It's nice to meet you," Peter says politely.
She smiles slightly.
"And you, Peter."
Peter can’t really tell what Selina thinks of him.

So long as she doesn’t pull a gun on him during their one-on-one time, it’ll be a…

“Good luck with that, Peter.”
Felicia comes back out, grabbing her purse and a leather jacket draped across the back…
“All right, I’m all set.”

“And don’t stay out too late.
It is a school night.”
Felicia rolls her eyes, but smirks.
Felicia takes his arm and leads him out of the apartment with one last wave to Selina.
Peter dutifully follows her out into the hall and down the stairs, jogging ahead a bit…

She seems nice,” Peter says, holding the door open for her.

It’s not raining for once, and it’s actually kind of nice out, and, uh, it’s just a…

“Sounds perfect.”

“Hey, Peter.
Thought you’d be at your, uh, part time job around this time,” he says.

Peter gives him a weak, nervous grin back.

He’s a little surprised by that.

“So, uh, what would you like to do?”

“You up for it?”

Good thing he gets paid tomorrow.
They take their skates, change into them and lock up their shoes.
Peter wobbles unsteadily on his feet for a moment before catching his balance.
Felicia notices that and grins.

But I should be pretty good at it,” he says.

His balance is perfect, after all.

He’s Spider-Man, after all.

And more than a little appreciative of it.

He will get the hang of this--
Felicia lets go of his hands and skates ahead of him.

Stop trying to control the blades and move with them.

He’s trying to stick the blades to the ground the way he sticks to the ground on his own…
It’s a subconscious habit, and one he often forgets about.
Usually that isn’t an issue.
Unless he happens to be ice skating, that is.
Felicia keeps hold of his hands until he starts to move on his own, matching her…

By the end of the hour, they’re skating beside each other, hand in hand.
After they finish skating, they start to wander around the park, walking along one of…

Worse than he already has, at least.
“It’s getting late,” she says.

“Yeah,” he says, automatically.
See you at school.”
Felicia gives him one last thoughtful look before walking towards the bus stop at the…

At least he’s not alone in this universe anymore.
